overviewParagraphs: The Norman Course at BRG Da Nang Golf Resort is a Greg Norman classic, widely regarded as the ultimate links-style challenge on Vietnam's Central Coast. Designed to mimic the raw, windswept layouts of the British Isles, the course utilizes the natural, rugged sand dunes of Da Nang.

Fairways are framed by native waste areas and scrub, requiring technical dominance and strategic shot-making rather than brute force. The greens are firm and fast, demanding precise approach shots. Hole 16, with its breathtaking coastal vistas, serves as the signature experience.

As part of the BRG Da Nang 36-hole complex, the Norman Course maintains the Gold Standard of hospitality, providing a mature and sophisticated infrastructure for the discerning international golf traveller.

curatorBriefHtml: BRG Da Nang Golf Resort’s Norman Course (opened 2010) is the original coastal classic that put Central Vietnam on the world golf map. Carved by Greg Norman through natural seaside sand dunes and mature casuarina pines, the Par 72 layout (7,160 yards) plays firm, fast, and rugged — culminating in the famous par-3 16th hole set right on Non Nuoc Beach with the East Sea and Cham Islands directly behind the green.

Having played the Norman Course personally many times, its charm lies in its old-school Australian Sandbelt-meets-links DNA: sprawling waste bunkers, tight green aprons that invite putter or hybrid recoveries from 30 yards out, and minimal water hazards so your score rises or falls on sand saves and wind control. Compare it directly against its next-door neighbor in BRG Da Nang vs. Montgomerie Links.
Located just 20 minutes from both Da Nang city and Hoi An, the Norman Course is a staple on our Central Coast Classic itinerary and pairs effortlessly with Hoiana Shores and Ba Na Hills.

scorecard.itemName: BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Norman Course)
scorecard.verdict: The pioneering layout that ignited Da Nang's reputation as a world-class golf destination. Classic Aussie-style dunes golf with expansive waste bunkers framed by casuarina pines and sea breezes.

faqs.q: What is the signature hole on the BRG Da Nang Norman Course?
faqs.a: The par-3 16th is one of Vietnam’s most photographed holes — playing directly toward Non Nuoc Beach with bunkers cut into natural dunes and the East Sea sparkling immediately behind the putting surface.

faqs.q: How does BRG Da Nang Norman compare to Montgomerie Links next door?
faqs.a: BRG Norman is firmer, rawer, and more sand-dune links oriented with sweeping waste areas and fewer water hazards. Montgomerie Links (5 minutes away) plays slightly softer and more parkland-resort style with tree-lined corridors and tighter greenside mounding.

faqs.q: How far is BRG Da Nang Norman from Hoi An and Da Nang hotels?
faqs.a: Only 15–20 minutes by private touring vehicle from central Da Nang hotels, An Bang Beach villas, or Hoi An Ancient Town — making morning tee times effortless.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play the Norman Course?
faqs.a: February through August brings dry coastal weather and fast, firm sand-dune turf. Morning tee times (07:30–08:45 AM) beat both midday heat and gusty afternoon sea breezes.
